integrity: The arbitrary-dimension statement is proved symbolically. The upper bound is an explicit simultaneous Waring decomposition; the lower bound is proved by a projection-dimension argument and cross-checked against the Alder--Strassen multiplication-rank bound. No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only split local commutative algebras with square-zero radical are classified.
Very recent literature may not yet be comprehensively indexed; an equivalent statement under an unsearched alias remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact evolution dimension of split square-zero local algebras
